primitives.name: Physiological State Estimator
primitives.verbatim_quote: US 9,743,848 B2 one example, given an elevated heart rate with little activity, the system may determine that it is possible the user drank coffee at that point.
primitives.assumptions: Elevated heart rate correlates with caffeine intake under low activity context.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When activity level exceeds threshold, coffee inference invalid.

layer2.mapping: Bayesian network linking HR and activity to caffeine likelihood via conditional probability P(coffee|HR, activity).
layer2.telemetry: Heart rate variability, activity duration, and user confirmation.

primitives.name: User Feedback Loop
primitives.verbatim_quote: In some cases, the feedback panel 1562 may prompt the user to confirm whether he/she indeed performed that activity in a user field 1572.
primitives.assumptions: User input improves model accuracy through active learning.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Feedback loop fails when user is inconsistent or disengaged.

layer2.mapping: Feedback kernel modifies prior belief distribution to posterior using Bayes' rule.
layer2.telemetry: User confirmation rate, error correction frequency.

primitives.name: Sleep Data Visualizer
primitives.verbatim_quote: A feedback panel 1580 associated with the sleep panel 1522 may present information on the user's sleep including, but not limited to, quantitative information, qualitative information, feedback, recommendations on future exercise routines, and the like.
primitives.assumptions: Sleep metrics correlate with exercise performance and recovery.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Visualizations fail when data is sparse or corrupted.

layer2.mapping: Time-series visualizations map physiological data to sleep quality via statistical descriptors.
layer2.telemetry: Sleep cycle duration, heart rate trends, REM percentage.

primitives.name: User Comparison Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: A user may be presented with user selection components representing other users who data is available for display.
primitives.assumptions: Comparative data enhances personalization and motivation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Comparison fails when user data is insufficient or misaligned.

layer2.mapping: Kernel-based similarity measure enables clustering of user profiles for comparative analytics.
layer2.telemetry: User profile overlap, similarity score distribution.
